card.line: Peor is a mountain peak in Moab overlooking the wasteland, where Balak took Balaam to curse Israel. Its name also marks a sad sin of Israel later.

moments.title: Balak takes Balaam up Peor
moments.text: Balak led Balaam to the top of Peor, hoping God would let him curse Israel from there. Balaam had seven altars built, and Balak offered a bull and a ram on each one.

moments.title: Balaam sees Israel and speaks
moments.text: Balaam saw that the LORD was pleased to bless Israel, so he did not look for omens. He looked up and saw Israel camped tribe by tribe, and the Spirit of God came upon him to speak a prophecy.
